page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.4xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 vCPUs mapped across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core using dedicated CPU allocation on a KVM hypervisor. The hardware includes 128.0 GB of RAM, offering a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It has no bundled local storage and includes a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps without dedicated GPUs. CPU features include AVX and AVX-512 extensions alongside AES hardware encryption support.

In performance testing, the instance exhibits moderate multi-core processing capabilities alongside weaker single-core speed. The Geekbench multi-core score of 5757.0 and stress-ng multi-core result of 11776.53 fall into average performance tiers, whereas single-core metrics such as a Geekbench single-core score of 893.0 and single-threaded gzip compression of 19.01 GB/sec rank lower. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 75.3 GB/sec, while write operations peak at 53.85 GB/sec. Application testing shows average throughput across Redis SET operations (11.19 million operations/sec), software compilation via Clang (10503.0), and static web serving (7.73 GB/sec).

The ecs.se1ne.4xlarge configuration balances high memory capacity with modest baseline compute power, providing cost-efficient resource density for memory-bound applications that do not require high single-threaded performance or integrated local NVMe storage. Because storage must be attached over the network, its 3 Gbps network capability is shared between data transfers and block storage I/O. This instance type is suited for in-memory caching systems, medium-scale relational and NoSQL databases, batch data processing, and enterprise web serving workloads requiring sub-128 GB memory footprints.
